the structure, function and dynamics of the photosystem II (P680)-LHCII supercomplex from the cyanobacterium Synechocystis sp. PCC6803.
the structure and function of the photosystem II supercomplex, which catalyses the water splitting reaction and the subsequent reduction of plastoquinone (PQ).
understanding the structural basis of energy conversion and the mechanism of water splitting in photosynthesis.
